name: Dover AFB
description: Home of the 436th Airlift Wing. Dover AFB is the Department of Defense's largest aerial port and primary East Coast air mobility hub, supporting global airlift operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays

events.title: Memorial 4-Player Scramble

events.description: Sign up for Eagle Creek’s Memorial 4-Player Scramble, honoring our Eagle Creek Golf Course members who have passed. Oct. 3 @ 8am. Prizes will be awarded. Call 302-677-2988 for pricing or visit the Pro Shop to register!

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Eagle's Rest Inn (302-677-2840) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (302-677-2074) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 436 FSS, M&FRC, and official Dover sites for in-processing and air mobility mission support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
